# MattePaint

> > MattePaint provides production-ready HDRI libraries, reference photography, and world-building assets for VFX, games, and digital media professionals.

Trusted by major studios including Disney, HBO, DNEG, and Goodbye Kansas Studios on productions like Shōgun and The Last of Us. MattePaint offers flexible licensing tiers with RAW, EXR, and JPG formats, plus the MattePaint Academy for VFX training with industry mentors.

## Key Topics

- HDRI library
- VFX assets
- World-building
- Matte painting
- Production-ready assets
- Commercial licensing
- RAW and EXR formats
- Environment art
- Reference photography
- Sky panoramas
- Credit system
- Team management
- Film and TV production
- MattePaint Academy
- Studio workflows

## Overview

- [MattePaint | World-building assets for VFX, Games, and Digital Media](https://mattepaint.com): Homepage showcasing MattePaint's HDRI library and production-ready assets
- [MattePaint Licensing | Find the right plan that fits your needs.](https://mattepaint.com/licensing): Complete licensing overview with personal, commercial, and global tiers
- [MattePaint HDRI Library](https://mattepaint.com/hdris): HDRI library overview with licensing options for commercial use

## Pricing & Plans

- [MattePaint Plans | No lock-in contracts, cancel anytime](https://mattepaint.com/plans): Main pricing page with Artist, Artist-Plus, Commercial, and Academy plans
- [MattePaint Personal plans, up to 16k](https://mattepaint.com/plans/personal): Personal subscription plans for freelancers under $100k yearly turnover
- [MattePaint Commercial License](https://mattepaint.com/plans/commercial): Studio plans for commercial projects with team management features

## Training & Education

- [MattePaint Academy](https://mattepaint.com/academy): VFX training with mentoring from industry professionals like Stefan Bernscherer

## Industry Solutions

- [Film & TV Assets](https://mattepaint.com/film-and-tv): Film & TV focused assets used by Disney, Goodbye Kansas Studios on Shōgun
- [Advertising Solutions](https://mattepaint.com/advertising): Advertising industry solutions with commercial licensing and HDRI assets
